ast.scope: Child source-bound partial syntax; no composed semantic AST.

obernants.assumptions: Treeagree Registry::load is built-in validation, not annotation model loading. CLI effect ordering is source-derived, not a release run. Syntax is partial lexical projection, no semantic expansion. Unicode case expansion before URL offsets, malformed coordinate arrays, arbitrary cyclic input and arithmetic extremes remain gaps; neither counts nor parser agreement establishes linguistic truth.
obernants.domain: Small synthetic plain-word UD trees, aligned witness vectors with valid heads; positive grouping chunk size; finite in-memory README/reference/index/count/render fixtures; bounded temporary parsecmp file. All arithmetic nonoverflow, allocations available; graph proposals assume acyclic conjunction paths. No real release build, corpus, parser/model loading, teacher or network.
obernants.observation_scope: Actual joins are proposal Edit positions into trial head/relation/retag vectors; baseline Bad equality into acceptance; Readme Item text/bib into Matcher with raw byte boundaries; Hit (Src,index,How,fuzzy) into collect Found and Card rendering; Counts into stats tuple and render totals. Synthetic readme_collect_render_join checks deduplication and rendering method/title. Parsecmp uses its own permissive reader and cannot substitute for treeagree read_ref: it skips range/dotted rows and uses sentinel heads where treeagree rejects nonsequential ten-column input.
obernants.operator: On admitted aligned shape-valid tree state, failed no_worse trial excludes candidate commit; treebank stats/meta rejection excludes all card writes. Parsecmp diagnostics exclude parser invocation and never repair trees. This inner exclusion is path-tagged; successful helper calls do not imply atomic release output.

A shared file is a safe adapter only on the intersection of these domains; a successful parsecmp read is insufficient evidence for treeagree validity.
